en.title: Layering Your Melody upon the Resonating Echoes
en.premise: Lumina has been liberated from the golden dominion, reclaiming its vibrant spectrum of colors. Kaito and Lira walk side by side in a new era where the resonance of sound shapes the very colors of the human heart. But one night, during the 'Festival of Bequeathed Sounds,' a 'Melody of the Dead'—a sound that should not exist—echoes through the streets. It is a song of last wills, conveying a lost soul's intent through music. Amidst a city bewildered by a flood of colors, Kaito's 'Void' and Lira's 'Truth' draw them into a new journey to find the missing fragments of sound.

zh.title: 在共鸣的残响中，叠加上你的旋律
zh.premise: 从黄金的支配中解脱，重新找回多样色彩的鲁米纳。凯托与莉拉在声音的共鸣塑造人们心中色彩的新时代中，共同前行。然而，在某夜造访城市的“留音祭”期间，本不该存在的“死者旋律”响彻全城。那是通过音乐传递他人意志的“遗言”之歌。在被氾滥的色彩所困惑的人群中，凯托的“空白”与莉拉的“真实”，引导他们踏上寻找失落之音碎片的新旅程。
